req.title: Player payload includes squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall include the squadNumber field on every response body under /players/.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-032 mandates that every response body under /players/ includes the squadNumber field. We test: (1) EP positive — GET /players/{id} for a known player returns HTTP 200 with squadNumber present and matching the exact seeded value; (2) NEG negative — GET /players/{id} with a non-existent UUID returns HTTP 404 (client error path, no body to check); (3) BVA boundary — the lowest squad number (1) and highest squad number (26) in the fixture both return squadNumber in the response, catching off-by-one mutations on range checks; (4) DT decision-table — verifies squadNumber value is an integer (not null, not string) and equals the exact seeded value, catching type-mutation and field-omission mutations; (5) EP positive for collection endpoint — GET /players/ returns a list where every element contains squadNumber, catching mutations that strip the field only from list responses.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_exact_value

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_exact_value():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'squadNumber' in body
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert isinstance(body['squadNumber'], int)

test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_exact_value()

tests.name: test_get_all_players_every_item_includes_squad_number
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
expected: Response is a list of 26 players
Every element in the list contains 'squadNumber' key with an integer value
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_every_item_includes_squad_number():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    players = r.json()
    assert isinstance(players, list)
    assert len(players) == 26
    for player in players:
        assert 'squadNumber' in player
        assert isinstance(player['squadNumber'], int)
        assert player['squadNumber'] >= 1

test_get_all_players_every_item_includes_squad_number()

tests.name: test_get_player_squad_number_field_exact_multiple_players
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Players with squadNumber 10 (Messi) and 23 (D. Martinez) exist
expected: squadNumber is never null or absent
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_player_squad_number_field_exact_multiple_players():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get('/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    b1 = r1.json()
    assert 'squadNumber' in b1
    assert b1['squadNumber'] == 10
    r2 = client.get('/players/01772c59-43f0-5d85-b913-c78e4e281452')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    b2 = r2.json()
    assert 'squadNumber' in b2
    assert b2['squadNumber'] == 23
    assert b1['squadNumber'] != b2['squadNumber']

test_get_player_squad_number_field_exact_multiple_players()
